units.source_text: 薰大将平居晏处之时，姿态比出门时更加漂亮。

en.t: When Captain Kaoru was relaxing at home, his appearance was even more handsome than when he went out.

units.source_text: 走进室中时，使得浮舟自感羞惭，但因室中无处躲避，只得坐着。

en.t: When he entered the room, Ukifune felt ashamed and embarrassed, but with nowhere in the room to hide, she could only remain seated.

units.source_text: 她的服饰由乳母等悉心置备，力求美观，然而不免略带乡村风度。

en.t: Her clothes had been carefully prepared by her nurse and the others, who had tried to make her look beautiful, yet they still had a slightly provincial air.

units.source_text: 薰大将不由得回想起大女公子常穿家常半旧衣服，丰姿反而高尚优雅。

en.t: Kaoru could not help recalling how the elder lady had often worn plain, half-worn everyday clothes, and yet had looked all the more noble and graceful.

units.source_text: 但浮舟的头发非常美丽，末端浓艳可爱。

en.t: But Ukifune's hair was extremely beautiful, with thick, glossy, lovely ends.

units.source_text: 薰大将看了，觉得不亚于二公主的美发。

en.t: Seeing it, Kaoru felt that it was no less beautiful than the Second Princess's fine hair.

units.source_text: 他考虑她的前途，想道：“我如何处置这个人呢？

en.t: Thinking about her future, he wondered, "How should I deal with this woman?

units.source_text: 如果现在立刻收作妻室，迎往三条宫邸，则深恐世人讥议。

en.t: If I were to take her as my wife at once and bring her to the Sanjo palace, I would greatly fear the criticism of the world.

units.source_text: 如把她列入大群侍女之中，对她和众人一律看待，则又非我本意。

en.t: If I placed her among the crowd of attendants and treated her the same as all the rest, that too would not be what I truly want.

units.source_text: 如此看来，只有暂时让她隐避在这山庄里。

en.t: Viewed this way, I can only let her stay hidden here in this mountain villa for the time being.

units.source_text: 然而不能常常见面，亦是一大缺憾。”

en.t: Yet not being able to see her often is also a great regret."

units.source_text: 他很可怜浮舟，诚恳亲切地和她谈话，直到天暮。

en.t: He felt great pity for Ukifune and spoke with her sincerely and kindly until dusk.

units.source_text: 其间也曾谈及已故八亲王之事。

en.t: During that time, they also spoke of the late Eighth Prince.

units.source_text: 又历叙往事，兴趣横生，庄谐杂作。

en.t: He also recounted events from the past one after another, and the conversation grew lively, mixing seriousness with playful wit.

units.source_text: 然而浮舟只是小心翼翼，羞羞答答，使得薰大将扫兴。

en.t: Yet Ukifune remained merely cautious and shy, which disappointed Kaoru.

units.source_text: 但他想：“这虽然是缺点，但小心谨慎总是好的，今后我当逐渐教养。

en.t: But he thought, "Although this is a flaw, caution and modesty are still good qualities, and from now on I will gradually guide and educate her.

units.source_text: 反之，如果染着村俗恶趣，品质不良，言行冒失，那才真个不配当大女公子的替身了。”

en.t: On the other hand, if she were tainted by vulgar provincial tastes, had a poor character, and spoke and acted rashly, then she truly would not be fit to stand in for the elder lady."
In the end, his displeasure turned into satisfaction.
